title: Basilisk House
summary: Basilisk House is a large bulding in Vienna, Austria, and the former resting place of King Basilisk's Amulet which was hidden deep within. A unique key was required to enter and map was needed to navigate its corridors.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The building was studied by Eathon Lambert with several detailed sketches and notes written in his journal. [Absent Heroes]

Zhalia Moon, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill were apprehended by DeFoe and his Suits while searching for the Amulet of King Basilisk, though the ensuing conflict allowed Zhalia to eventually bond with the Titan. [Absent Heroes]
